choose.when: SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) != TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) AND c.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND c.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) = TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) AND c.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND c.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) != TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) AND c.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND c.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT r.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0 AND r.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND r.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY r.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT r.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0 AND r.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND r.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY r.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

mapper.select: SELECT op AS "value", NVL((SELECT s.staff_name FROM tr_staff_dict s WHERE s.staff_code = op AND ROWNUM = 1), op) AS "label" FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT c.OPERATOR_NO AS op FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c UNION SELECT DISTINCT r.OPERATOR_NO FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r ) ORDER BY op

SELECT period AS "period", metric AS "metric", SUM(cnt) AS "cnt" FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) AS period, '预约挂号量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 1 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1
GROUP BY TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) AS period, '预约取号量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) != TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE)
GROUP BY TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) AS period, '当日挂号量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) = TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE)
GROUP BY TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE) AS period, '退号量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.RETURNED_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 AND c.REGISTRATION_STATUS <> 0
GROUP BY TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE) AS period, '门诊收费量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0
GROUP BY TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE) AS period, '门诊退费量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0
GROUP BY TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(p.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(p.stat_date) AS period, '收预交金量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM tr_inpat_prepay_rcpt p WHERE p.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND p.transact_type = '交款'
GROUP BY TRUNC(p.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(p.stat_date) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(p.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(p.stat_date) AS period, '退院量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM tr_inpat_prepay_rcpt p WHERE p.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND p.transact_type = '退款'
GROUP BY TRUNC(p.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(p.stat_date) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(m.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(m.stat_date) AS period, '出院结算量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM tr_settle_master m WHERE m.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY TRUNC(m.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(m.stat_date) ) GROUP BY period, metric ORDER BY period, metric
